message: Every time I upload a CSV larger than 5 MB I get error 504. Smaller files go through fine.

classification.rationale: The message describes an error occurring when uploading larger files, indicating a problem with the product.

enrichment.core_issue: The customer receives error 504 when uploading CSV files larger than 5 MB.

summary: The customer reports receiving error 504 when uploading CSV files larger than 5 MB, while smaller files upload successfully. This indicates a potential issue with file size handling in the product.
